source: Exported from the published place (ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig, ServerScriptService.LootConfig, ServerStorage.Items) with fresh module copies

Baseball Bat.Description: Solid wood, taped grip. Knocks them back.

Batteries.Description: A few AA batteries. Puts charge back in your headlamp the moment you pick them up.

Crowbar.Description: Pry bar. Two swings take a plank down and you keep the wood. Works on the infected in a pinch.

Extended Battery.Description: A high-capacity battery pack for your headlamp: twice the light on a charge. Fitted on pickup.

First Aid Kit.Description: Bandages and antiseptic. Patches you up.

Gas Can.Description: A red jerry can, about a third full. Runs a generator for one whole night (hold E at a generator).

Hammer.Description: Heavy claw hammer. Slow, but it staggers what it hits and sends it flying. Builders will want one.

Hunting Rifle.Description: Bolt-action hunting rifle with a scope. Uses Rifle Rounds. One per survivor, from Dr. Vance's office.

LED Bulb.Description: A proper LED for your headlamp: brighter, wider, further. Fitted the moment you pick it up.

Lantern.Description: Kerosene camp lantern. Lights your way, or set it down (click) to light a room or a base. Pick it back up any time.

Machete.Description: Rusty but sharp. Hits harder than a bat.

Military Helmet.Description: Combat helmet. Hold it and press fire to wear it: takes 15% of every hit until it wears out. Only found at Blackpine Airfield.

Mini AK.Description: Compact AK-pattern carbine. Fully automatic, 20 rounds, uses Rifle Rounds. Loud. Very rare: only at Blackpine Airfield.

Plate Carrier.Description: Military plate carrier. Hold it and press fire to wear it: takes 40% of every hit until it wears out. Only found at Blackpine Airfield.

Signal Remote.Description: A rewired TV remote. Press it near the infected: everything close by freezes for 5 seconds and takes damage. Recharges in 30 seconds.

Tactical Reflector.Description: Military reflector housing. Turns your headlamp into a floodlight. Fitted the moment you pick it up.

features.name: 8-minute day, 5-minute night
features.verifiedBy: Play test: Day 1 daylight phase 440 s (+40 s dusk), night phase 300 s

features.name: Night hunting
features.verifiedBy: Play test, Night 1 in Stillwater: hunters rose 0→5→6→7→8 over 40 s, staggered; chases followed

features.name: Gunshots draw the infected
features.verifiedBy: Existing system (Zombies.noise from WeaponService: 90 studs, 120 for shotguns and loud guns); scream alerts capped

features.name: Ammo from kills
features.verifiedBy: Play test: 60 credited kills → 12 drops (20%), 20 uncredited deaths → 0; 20,000-roll distribution 18.0% / 21.4%

features.name: Green wisps
features.verifiedBy: Play test: a relic wisp led camp → crypt arch; a stash wisp left 2 items

features.name: Night caches
features.verifiedBy: Play test: 0 by day, 5 at night with glow and prompt; search gave loot

features.name: Sleep until dawn
features.verifiedBy: Play test (solo): 233 s of night left → -25 health and Dawn; infected nearby blocks it
notVerified: On-screen prompt card (capture tool doesn't draw prompt cards)

features.name: Soldier infected

features.name: Rare military gear director

features.name: Plate Carrier and Military Helmet

features.name: Mini AK
